idea-plugin.name: K Code Review
idea-plugin.description:
AI-powered Git commit code review with SonarQube-style findings.

K Code Review analyzes staged or committed changes with Gemini, OpenAI, Anthropic, or Qwen, then shows severity, category, explanation, how-to-fix steps, and an Applyable suggested fix.

Highlights

  • Pre-commit gate — reviews staged files; blocks once on findings; second Commit proceeds
  • Analysis panel — warning list + detail inspector with numbered How to fix steps
  • Suggested Fix + Apply — insert the proposed snippet at the finding location
  • Multi-model — Gemini 3.x / Flash latest, Qwen, Claude, GPT, Custom endpoint
  • Secure API keys — stored in IntelliJ PasswordSafe (never in project files)
  • Custom prompts — optional remote prompt URL override

Getting started

  1. Settings → Tools → K Code Review → paste your LLM API key and pick a model
  2. Tools → K Code Review → Review Latest Commit (or enable pre-commit review)
  3. Open the K Code Review tool window for details and Apply fix
